findings.quote: Goldman sits above consensus at +0.39% headline and +0.23% core.
findings.why: The context records Goldman's headline forecast of 0.39% against a 0.4% consensus and says the forecast is 'slightly above consensus for core' only, so the headline number is not above consensus.
findings.fix: Say Goldman is above consensus on core at +0.23% and in line to a touch below on headline at +0.39% against a 0.4% consensus.

findings.quote: Société Générale calls energy the most attractive hedge in equities against exactly this risk and is long $XLE for it
findings.why: The context has Société Générale identifying energy and financials as the most attractive hedges but records no long $XLE position or any energy-equity instrument call from the desk.
findings.fix: Drop 'and is long $XLE for it' and keep only that Société Générale names energy (alongside financials) as the most attractive equity hedge.

findings.quote: US stocks opened lower for a third straight session
findings.why: Deutsche Bank's 10 September note says the S&P 500 fell for a third consecutive day through Wednesday's close, which makes today's decline the fourth, and no context entry describes an opening-gap streak.
findings.fix: Change to a fourth straight down session, or drop the streak count and state only that stocks opened lower again.
